scientific_integrity: The results arise from direct orbit-stabilizer arguments and are supported by an independently implemented finite-case enumerator. Earlier simultaneous-diagonalization is not claimed as new. No external independent mathematical validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: This theorem compares clique counts, not isomorphism classes of complete commuting graphs in arbitrary rank.
Existing pairwise simultaneous-diagonalization theorems are explicitly acknowledged.
An equivalent orbit-count formula in older finite-module or Hall-algebra literature remains possible.
Finite computational checks do not constitute an infinite proof.
title: All-arity idempotent clique spectra of finite abelian \(p\)-groups and an invisible exponent
